A constant, with identifier `Capacity`, limits the size of the stack to 25 items.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write the pseudocode for the required declarations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Complete the pseudocode function `Pop()` to pop an item from `Stack`.

```text
// popping an item from the stack
FUNCTION Pop() [[blank]]
    DECLARE Item : REAL
    Item ← 0

    [[blank]] BasePointer THEN
        Item ← [[blank]]
        TopPointer ← [[blank]]
    ELSE
        OUTPUT "The stack is empty - error"
    ENDIF

    [[blank]]
ENDFUNCTION
```
